homePage.descriptionInput: To be able to use the application you need to follow the steps below:
homePage.stepTwo: Generate your api key if you don't already have one.
homePage.stepThree: Enter it in the field below and save.
homePage.stepFour: If you want to delete the key, just press delete.
homePage.invalidKey: This does not look like a TMDB key.
homePage.keyNotPersisted: The key could not be saved to disk, so it is kept only until the app closes.
homePage.keyNotEncrypted: This system has no keyring, so the key is saved without encryption.
